answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the relic of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the fable re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
